scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=backend & npm run dev --workspace=frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@kshiai/shared && npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:deployment
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:deployment
scripts.build:worker: npm run build --workspace=@kshiai/shared && npm run build --workspace=frontend && wrangler deploy --config infra/cloudflare-worker/wrangler.jsonc --dry-run
scripts.static: npm run static:jscpd && npm run static:lizard
scripts.static:jscpd: jscpd --config .jscpd.json backend/src frontend/src packages/shared/src infra/cloudflare-worker/src scripts
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && npm run static
